visual: Black background with multicolour radial data bars, thin white type, softly lit dark cards, four compact growth charts and a purple closing section.
judgment: One of the strongest references for making infrastructure tangible through visible data and developer entry points.
role: Oracle/data network. PYTH governance and oracle-integrity collateral staking; not the required currency for ordinary feed payments.
routes: Terminal, price feeds, docs, code examples, applications and demo links.
loop: Feed exploration and integration resources connect marketing to recurring practical work.
trust: Public data and developer routes support inspection; metrics and customer claims unverified.
counter: Glowing cards and award badges add clutter; some live charts loaded incompletely in capture.
principle: Let the product's data supply the visual identity and the proof below the hero.
avoid: Do not fabricate live metrics or copy the branded radial mark.
idea: A PONS tools site could preview launch activity, graduation progress and integration examples with clearly sourced data.
limitations: Some dynamic price charts remained partially drawn; static capture does not establish live feed reliability.
